dTip.age: Isixwayisi: Ukuguga akunakugwema. Hlukanisa ngaphambi kokufa.
dTip.eaten: Isixwayisi: Gwema izingeli, sebenzisa Isikhathi Somsoco ukubalekela.
dTip.lysis: Isixwayisi: Ukuqhekezeka kubangwa amagciwane. Qhubeka kude nawo.
dTip.starve: Isixwayisi: Yidla njalo, hlala eduze nokudla, noma guqula isivinini.
dTip.temp: Isixwayisi: Buka umlinganiseli wobushushu. Guqula indawo yakho yobushushu.
demo.tip: ISIBONELO · ukundiza nge-WASD/imawusi · 1-6 eqoqweni · chofoza = thata iseli
edu.chloro.desc: Ukukhiqiza ngokukhanya: ukukhanya + CO₂ + H₂O → ushukela + O₂. Luhlaza nge-chlorophyll. Kutholakala ezitshalweni nasemanzini.
edu.chloro.name: I-Chloroplast
edu.cilia.desc: Izinwele ezincane ezihambahambayo. Zenza imimoya yamanzi: ukunyakaza + ukudla ngokuhlunga (kudonsa amabhaktiriya nezitshalo zasemanzini emlonyeni).
edu.cilia.name: Izinwele ezincane
edu.cyto.desc: Ingxenye yangaphakathi yeseli: amanzi, amaphrotheni, ama-organelle. Izinkulungwane zemisebenzi yamakhemikhali zenzeka lapha.
edu.cyto.name: I-Cytoplasm
edu.flagella.desc: Umshini wokushuma omde. Ujikeleza noma ugobile — iseli iyashuma iye ekudleni noma ibaleke engozini (i-chemotaxis).
edu.flagella.name: I-Flagellum
edu.hoverHint: Shova ichashazi engaphakathi kweseli — igama lendima yelungo nomsoco
edu.membrane.desc: Isiphapho esincene samafutha. Silawula okungena nokuphuma. Iseli ngasinye sinaso.
edu.membrane.name: Isiphapho
edu.mito.desc: Isikhungo samandla seseli. Ukuphefumula: ushukela + O₂ → ATP (amandla). Sine-DNA waso — usalelo lwebhaktiriya yakudala.
edu.mito.name: I-Mitochondrion
edu.nucleoid.desc: Indawo ene-DNA eyisicingo emabhaktiriyeni. Ayinalo ikhava — i-DNA iyakhululeka ngaphakathi kweseli.
edu.nucleoid.name: I-Nucleoid
edu.nucleus.desc: Igcina i-DNA. Ilawula ukukhula, ukuhlukanisa nokwenza amaphrotheni. Amabhaktiriya awanalo i-Nucleus eqotho — i-DNA ihlezi ku-Nucleoid.
edu.nucleus.name: I-Nucleus
edu.oral.desc: Kumcikilizi — umugqa lapho izinwele ezincane zidonsa ukudla khona. Ukudla kungena ku-vacuole yokugaya kusukela lapha.
edu.oral.name: Umugqa womlomo
edu.vacuole.desc: Isiphevu esinamanzi, okulondoloza noma ama-enzyme okugaya. Umcikilizi unama-vacuole okugaya nokuqoqamanisi.
edu.vacuole.name: I-Vacuole
edu.wall.desc: Isakhiwo esiqinile ngaphandle kwesiphapho (peptidoglycan emabhaktiriyeni, i-cellulose ezitshalweni). Ukusekelwa kanye nomumo.
edu.wall.name: Udonga lweseli
help.body:
Izilawuli: WASD ukushuma. Isikhala = ukuloma. Ikhohlo le-mawusi = shuma lapho ikhomba khona.

Ubani udla ubani:

🌱 Okuluhlaza kudla ukukhanya. 🔵 Abadli abancane badla okuluhlaza. 🟠 Abadli abaphakathi bahlunga amabhaktiriya+okuluhlaza. 🟣 Izingeli ezinkulu zidla okuluhlaza, amabhaktiriya nabadli abaphakathi — futhi zingaloma ukudla okukhulu kancane.

Ikhamera: F ikhamera yamahhala, V buyela eselini. Iwili = ukusondeza.

Ukuhlukanisa: Yidla, khula, hlukanisa. Q = ngesandla.
lb.title: 🏆 Ibhodi yabaphambili
mapTip: Imephu encane: ukuphi echibini. Chofoza ukuze ikhamera igijime lapho.
menuSub: Ukulingisa izinhlwandi — {n} izinhlobo + amagciwane. Ukubuka okusikiwe kwechibi.
midEaterTip: Umdlali wesiphakathi: shuma uye kweziluhlaza noma amabhaktiriya. Izinwele ezincane ziyahlunga zona.
poolWill: Ichibi lizoba ne: ~{n} izinto eziphilayo · {kinds} izinhlobo
popTip: Igrafu yabaningi: bangaki izinhlwandi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
role.consumer1: Abadli abancane (amabhaktiriya). Badla okuluhlaza kancane. Ukudla kwabadli abaphakathi nabakhulu.
role.consumer2: Abadli abaphakathi (abomcikilizi). Bahlunga amanzi: badonsa amabhaktiriya nokuluhlaza. Bangalingani nezinkulu.
role.consumer3: Izingeli ezinkulu. Zidla okuluhlaza, amabhaktiriya nabadli abaphakathi. Zingaloma ukudla okukhulu kancane — kuyingozi. Ziphila isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokudla, kodwa indlala iyazibulala.
role.macrophage: Abavikeli. Bahlasela amaseli agula/engozi — umkhosi wechibi.
role.producer: Okuluhlaza. Akukho uzinyelo. Kudla ukukhanya namanzi — izitshalo ezincane. Kondla abanye bonke.
roleHint: Isixwayisi: ukudla kunophawu olunombala. Ibha yephunga lokudla iphezulu ngakwesokudla.
tip.ageBar: Ubudala besidalwa. Amaseli amdala alahlekelwa amandla ngokushesha.
tip.cbFilter: Isihlungi sezidalwa. Chofoza ukubona luhlobo lodwa kumenyu.
tip.daysL: Izinsuku zomdlalo. Ukushintsha kwesizini kushintsha ubushushu.
tip.energyBar: Amandla esidalwa. Ayancipha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Eziweni — ukufa ngendlala.
tip.fly: Ukundiza okukhululekile: F noma i-WASD / imawusi
tip.popC: Igrafu yabaningi. Ibonisa umlando wokuzalwa nokufa.
tip.tempL: Ubushushu bamanzi. Bushintsha imisebenzi yomzimba nokuphila.
toast.cyst.enter: Isipora: kuvikelekile, isivinini 0, amandla ayancipha kancane
toast.eat.noneAuto: Ayikho ukudla eduze — vula IYAZENZELA noma sondezela
toast.microOn: 🔬 Imayikhroskophu: amanzi ahlala, ukusondeza+ugridi (ayona imodi N)
tut.s1.body: Uyisidalwa esincane echibini. Injongo: yidla, khula, hlukanisa. Chofoza Okulandelayo.
tut.s1.title: Wamukelekile
tut.s2.body: Sebenzisa i-WASD ukushuma. Imawusi ikhomba isiqondiso. Nyakaza, bese uchofoza Okulandelayo.
tut.s2.title: Ukunyakaza
tut.s3.body: Shuma uye kuseli encane bese uchofoza YIDLA (E). Uzobona ukukhanya okusheshayo.
tut.s3.title: Ukudla
tut.s4.body: Uma amandla egcwele, chofoza HLUKANISA (Q). Iseli iba ncane. Kuyajwayelekile lokho.
tut.s4.title: Ukuhlukanisa
tut.s5.body: Ikhamera: landela noma undiza mahhala. Ngikufisela inhlanhla ekuthuthukiseni!
tut.s5.title: Kuqedile
